content:
morgan: Quick sync — planning to roll runtime v2.3.1 tonight in the 01:00-02:00 UTC change window. It changes KV eviction heuristics and kernel selection. Need API/Console/Router alignment; deploy-bot already has a tentative wave. Any showstoppers?

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave 'runtime-v2.3.1' at 2026-03-23T01:00Z. Canary: 5% for 10m, then ramp on pass. Auto-abort if errors > +3% or p95 latency +200ms.

anya: :eyes: What compatibility risks specifically? Does API depend on cache hit semantics? Console relies on prefix cache for list endpoints.

sam: Router note — this runtime bumps the kernel requirement and will reject requests missing header x-service-compat in debug routes. Older sidecars may return 400 for /internal/debug if header absent. We can temp rewrite headers in the router shim but need to coordinate rollout ordering.

olivia: Suggest staged rollout: EU canary -> US canary -> global. Keep a fallback runtime variant (runtime:v2.2.9) pinned for the API route group so deploy-bot can quickly switch traffic back. I'll create a dashboard with these guards: error-rate, kv-hit-rate, generation latency.

paul: I'll own rollback/abort. Confirm exact rollback commands and who has privileges. Also who will run the manual unpin if deploy-bot aborts?

morgan: Good point. Runbook snippet (to include in release notes):

```
# Abort and fallback
deploy-bot abort --wave runtime-v2.3.1
# Pin old runtime for api-route-group
redwoodctl config set route/api-route-group.runtime_pin runtime:v2.2.9 --force
# Health check (quick)
curl -sS https://api.internal/health | jq .runtime
```

anya: OK. Console migration: schema v1.2 -> v1.3 is backwards compatible for reads but some UI tiles use eviction metrics. We'll keep the feature flag off until runtime reaches 50% traffic. I'll push the flag toggle to the release notes with the exact FF key.

sam: Router team will land header-rewrite shim in the next 30m and can toggle it on at canary start. We'll also add a short rule to drop the x-debug header for canary traffic to avoid the 400s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (5%) — timestamped in wave log. Auto-checks: 10m window for error delta and latency.

olivia: I've wired the dashboard panels: p95 latency, error delta, kv hit-rate, and eviction-rate. Default abort thresholds: error +3%, p95 +200ms, kv-hit -10%. Alert channel: #incidents and paging to @paul. Link: https://dash.internal/d/abc123/runtime-rollout (add to release notes).

paul: I'll be on-call 00:30-02:30 UTC and reachable via phone. If abort fires, I'll run the `deploy-bot abort` then execute the runtime pin command. Confirmed I have permissions.

morgan: Final checklist before window: 1) Release notes with rollback commands & FF keys (anya) 2) Router shim landed and togglable (sam) 3) Dashboard + alerts live (olivia) 4) Paul on-call and runbook steps copied into the wave (paul) 5) Deploy-bot schedule set to EU -> US -> global with ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%.

anya: Added the release note snippet and FF keys. Will not flip the console feature flag until 50% pass confirmed.

sam: Shim PR merged, staging smoke passed. Will watch router logs during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary passed 10m smoke, ramping to 20% now.

olivia: Dashboard shows stable kv-hit and p95 within thresholds. No error signal.

morgan: Nice. Keep the traffic plan but keep the auto-abort rules strict. If anything odd, call abort and we'll pin back. Thanks all — I'll update the release channel after global 100%. :thumbsup:

paul: Copy. Standing by.

anya: Thanks team.

sam: 👍

olivia: :rocket:

morgan: Closing thread — will post final status when done.
